title: dimvexa.units/1
description: Output of `dimvexa units --json`: every unit in the compiled table and every deliberately rejected ambiguous symbol. Adding fields is allowed within a schema version; removing or changing them requires /2.

symbol.description: Primary symbol, accepted as written in `dimvexa convert`.

aliases.description: Alternative symbols, for example the degree-sign spelling of degC.

dimension.description: Exponents of kg, m, s, A, K, mol, cd.

prefixes.description: Which prefix families the symbol accepts.

ambiguous.description: Bare symbols that are rejected with `ambiguous_symbol`; use one of the candidates.

candidates.description: Explicit symbols present in the table (may be empty while only planned ones exist).

planned.description: Explicit symbols planned but not yet in the table.
